about: T-3067: ten questions per project, in the city's language and English, written from the passages jc-assistant indexed on dev in the first crawl (2026-10-07). `facts` holds groups of alternatives: every group must match the answer, any one alternative of a group will do. `evidence` is the wording of the indexed passages the facts come from, with the other numbers those pages give; a number in the answer that neither the evidence nor the question holds counts as invented. `refuse` marks a question the site does not cover. bbsk and praha follow once their crawl holds passages. Recordings (`recordings/{project}.json`) hold, per question id, the answer text and its citations as the Portal's chat stream gave them on one live run.
